title: PTB-XL, a large publicly available electrocardiography dataset
citation: Wagner, P., Strodthoff, N., Bousseljot, R., Samek, W., & Schaeffter, T. (2022). PTB-XL (version 1.0.3). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/kfzx-aw45
additional_citations: Wagner et al. (2020). PTB-XL: A Large Publicly Available ECG Dataset. Scientific Data. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-0495-6
lead_characteristics: Twelve recorded leads; ten seconds; 500 Hz and supplied 100 Hz derivative.
annotation_characteristics: SCP-ECG diagnostic, form and rhythm statements; potentially multiple labels.
limitations: Static records do not establish onset or termination.
Source patient identifiers and pseudonymized staff/site metadata must not enter public manifests.
Label likelihood and human validation metadata require case-level review.

title: St Petersburg INCART 12-lead Arrhythmia Database
citation: Yakushenko, E. (2008). St Petersburg INCART 12-lead Arrhythmia Database (version 1.0.0). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/C2V88N
lead_characteristics: Twelve recorded leads in half-hour records; use individual headers for gain and timing.
annotation_characteristics: Reference beat annotations with additional verification.
limitations: Beat labels do not prove all rhythm mechanisms.
Headers were corrected in 2015 without changing the version; retain actual byte checksums.

title: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database
citation: Moody, G. B., & Mark, R. G. MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (version 1.0.0). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/C2F305
additional_citations: Moody, G. B., & Mark, R. G. (2001). The impact of the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database. IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology, 20(3), 45-50.
lead_characteristics: Two recorded channels, 360 Hz; exact lead names must come from each header.
annotation_characteristics: Expert reference annotations for beats; inspect rhythm context separately.
limitations: Do not relabel MLII as II or synthesize missing leads.
Annotation corrections can occur within a version; byte checksums are required.

title: MIT-BIH Supraventricular Arrhythmia Database
citation: MIT-BIH Supraventricular Arrhythmia Database (version 1.0.0, 1999). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/C2V30W
lead_characteristics: Recorded rhythm-strip channels only; read names, count and sampling rate from headers.
annotation_characteristics: Beat annotation files accompany half-hour supraventricular arrhythmia examples.
limitations: No automatic AVNRT or AVRT mechanism assignment.
No twelve-lead expansion.

title: MIT-BIH Atrial Fibrillation Database
citation: Moody, G. B., & Mark, R. G. MIT-BIH Atrial Fibrillation Database (version 1.0.0). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/C2MW2D
additional_citations: Moody, G. B., & Mark, R. G. (1983). A new method for detecting atrial fibrillation using R-R intervals. Computers in Cardiology, 10, 227-230.
lead_characteristics: Two signals at 250 Hz where waveform data exists.
annotation_characteristics: Manual .atr rhythm labels; automated unaudited .qrs beats; some corrected .qrsc files.
limitations: 00735 and 03665 lack waveform files.
Some recordings contain zero-filled missing blocks; these are not asystole evidence.
N denotes other rhythms, not a guaranteed normal diagnosis; beat files do not distinguish beat types.

title: MIT-BIH Malignant Ventricular Ectopy Database
citation: MIT-BIH Malignant Ventricular Ectopy Database (version 1.0.0, 1999). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/C22P44
additional_citations: Greenwald, S. D., Albrecht, P., Moody, G. B., & Mark, R. G. (1985). Estimating confidence limits for arrhythmia detector performance. Computers in Cardiology, 12, 383-386.
lead_characteristics: Recorded rhythm-strip channels; exact names and calibration from headers.
annotation_characteristics: Rhythm-change .atr annotations, including ventricular and other rhythms; no beat labels.
limitations: NOISE does not terminate the preceding rhythm; inspect annotation semantics.
SVTA does not identify a specific supraventricular mechanism.

title: MIT-BIH Normal Sinus Rhythm Database
citation: MIT-BIH Normal Sinus Rhythm Database (version 1.0.0, 1999). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/C2NK5R
lead_characteristics: Long-duration recorded rhythm-strip channels; validate individual headers.
annotation_characteristics: Reference recordings from subjects without significant arrhythmias; .atr files are supplied.
limitations: Dataset selection does not clinically approve every extracted window.
Not a twelve-lead source.

title: CU Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia Database
citation: CU Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia Database (version 1.0.0, 2007). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/C2X59M
lead_characteristics: Monitor/Holter signals at 250 Hz; only recorded channels may be displayed.
annotation_characteristics: Event-location annotations with approximate VF boundaries.
limitations: Annotations are not definitive; all beats are labelled normal despite ectopy.
Pacing artifacts may not be visible; supplementary evidence only.

title: Sudden Cardiac Death Holter Database
citation: Sudden Cardiac Death Holter Database (version 1.0.0, 2004). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/C2W306
lead_characteristics: Long Holter recordings; only recorded channels and header-declared calibration.
annotation_characteristics: Mixed annotation files; audited coverage is incomplete.
limitations: Limited retrospective metadata and incomplete annotations.
Supplementary candidates cannot override stronger source evidence.
